lines.speaker: pa
lines.text: Attention, all personnel. Lab B is under routine quarantine. Please keep clear of the east corridor.

lines.speaker: crew_mess
lines.text: Morning, officer. Coffee's terrible again.

lines.speaker: medic
lines.text: Legs! Take its legs!

lines.speaker: medic
lines.text: You go down, I'll get you up. If I go down, we're both done.

lines.speaker: medic
lines.text: Movement, left side!

lines.speaker: engineer
lines.text: Cover me, I'll get this open!

lines.speaker: engineer
lines.text: Agh! It got me!

lines.speaker: engineer
lines.text: I'll get the panel, go.

lines.speaker: engineer
lines.text: Cut it on the panel. It's nothing.

lines.speaker: engineer
lines.text: That door's sealed. Maybe there's another way round?

lines.speaker: medic
lines.text: Clear. Everyone breathing?

lines.speaker: medic
lines.text: Quiet. Something's in the water.

lines.speaker: engineer
lines.text: I didn't want you to see this.

lines.speaker: crew_lab
lines.text: [screaming]

lines.speaker: pa
lines.text: Day shift, please badge in at the docking ring. Night shift, thank you for your service.

lines.speaker: medic
lines.text: Morning, officer. Still on that door since four?

lines.speaker: engineer
lines.text: Look at that posture. Part of the wall by now.

lines.speaker: medic
lines.text: Anything to report from the night?

lines.speaker: engineer
lines.text: A nod. I'll take it. Quiet's the best report there is.

lines.speaker: medic
lines.text: Giles, you look worse than the pipes.

lines.speaker: engineer
lines.text: Four hours of sleep and a bunk that hates me. Don't diagnose before coffee.

lines.speaker: medic
lines.text: It's not a diagnosis. It's an observation.

lines.speaker: engineer
lines.text: Then observe me toward the kitchen. Officer, with us?

lines.speaker: engineer
lines.text: Lab B again. Haven't seen one of those researchers in the mess all week.

lines.speaker: medic
lines.text: Routine means the paperwork was filed. It doesn't say why.

lines.speaker: medic
lines.text: Arm bothering you?

lines.speaker: engineer
lines.text: Slept on it wrong. Walk it off.

lines.speaker: medic
lines.text: Tell me if it keeps bothering you.

lines.speaker: engineer
lines.text: It's a sore arm, Tomas, not a surgical case.

lines.speaker: crew_cook
lines.text: Morning, all. Coffee's terrible again, before anyone asks.

lines.speaker: engineer
lines.text: Terrible is generous. I'll take two.

lines.speaker: medic
lines.text: One. Caffeine isn't a food group.

lines.speaker: crew_tech
lines.text: Third quarantine this month. Anyone know what's actually in Lab B?

lines.speaker: crew_cook
lines.text: Nobody tells the kitchen anything. We just hear the pipes.

lines.speaker: medic
lines.text: Sit, officer. That's medical advice.

lines.speaker: engineer
lines.text: Last quiet cup before the day starts.

lines.speaker: medic
lines.text: Drink up. Briefing's in ten minutes.
